card.name: Colorectal cancer combination regimen wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words and spaces in oncology label text about colorectal cancer drugs, such as 'with' after 'in combination' or the space between 'exon' and a number. Also fires inside names like CYRAMZA.

modes.label: Linking words in combination therapy
modes.description: The words 'with', 'and' or 'received' right after 'in combination' or a patient count, before a partner drug like FOLFOX or trastuzumab.
modes.example: 272 patients with RAS- mutant mCRC tumors received Vectibix in combination<< with>> FOLFOX and 276

modes.label: Spaces in exon and codon lists
modes.description: The space before a number in lists of RAS mutation exons and codons.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens show no clear link to the text, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in colorectal cancer drug combination text, just before the partner drug or number comes up.
